volumeInfo.title: La verdad sobre el caso Harry Quebert
volumeInfo.description: August 30, 1975: the day fifteen-year-old Nola Kellergan is seen being chased through the woods before disappearing from the small town of Aurora, New Hampshire. Thirty-three years later, Marcus Goldman, a successful young novelist, visits Aurora to stay with his mentor, Harry Quebert, one of the country's most respected writers, only to learn that Harry has been having an affair with Nola.

volumeInfo.title: El enigma de la habitación 622
volumeInfo.description: A murder in room 622 of the luxurious Palace de Verbier hotel in the Swiss Alps sets the stage for a gripping and intricate mystery. Years after the unsolved crime, a writer staying at the same hotel becomes intrigued by the unanswered questions surrounding the case. As he pieces together testimonies from guests and staff, he uncovers a complex web of ambition, betrayal, and corporate power struggles within a prestigious Swiss private bank. What initially appears to be a simple crime slowly reveals itself as a carefully orchestrated conspiracy involving love, greed, and hidden identities.

volumeInfo.title: El Libro de los Baltimore
volumeInfo.description: Before the tragedy that changed everything, there were two branches of the Goldman family: the Goldmans of Montclair and the glamorous Goldmans of Baltimore. Growing up, Marcus Goldman idolized his Baltimore cousins, whose wealth, success, and apparent perfection stood in sharp contrast to his own modest upbringing. But beneath the surface of privilege and admiration lay jealousy, rivalry, and secrets that would eventually tear the family apart. As Marcus reflects on his youth and the events that led to the mysterious 'Tragedy,' he slowly uncovers the truth about loyalty, love, and the fragile bonds that hold families together.
